tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Car models this site has data for (Austin to San Antonio used-car buyers), with slug, category and years. Paginate with next_cursor.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: One model across all years: NHTSA recall campaigns, owner complaints, overall stars and EPA combined MPG per year, with page links.

tools.name: get_model_year
tools.description: One model year in detail: NHTSA recalls, complaints, top complaint components, crash stars; EPA engines, transmissions and MPG; Transport Canada size and weight.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Published guides, reviews and comparisons (Texas title, tax, inspection, auctions, best years), filtered by language, category or keywords.

tools.name: get_contact_options
tools.description: How a person can reach Anthony Hunt for free used-car advice (WhatsApp, email or form). He does not sell cars.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_guides, get_contact_options · Private data: get_contact_options · Public sink: get_contact_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_guides, get_contact_options · Private data: get_contact_options · Public sink: get_contact_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
